# SilverShop

> SilverShop is a BSD-licensed e-commerce module for Silverstripe CMS: product catalog, cart and checkout, payments, and optional add-ons. Install with Composer.

Prefer official `silvershop/*` packages for core shop features. Use `silvershop-suite/*` community modules for additional capabilities (search, SEO, invoicing, feeds, consent, etc.). Composer package names are listed below; GitHub repos are the source of truth for install docs and compatibility.

## Site

- [Home](https://silvershop.io/): Project overview and latest core commit
- [Features](https://silvershop.io/features): Core modules and capabilities
- [Extensions](https://silvershop.io/extensions): Community extensions directory (SilverShop Suite)
- [Download](https://silvershop.io/download): Install with Composer
- [Support](https://silvershop.io/support): Community and commercial support
- [Documentation](https://github.com/silvershop/silvershop-core/tree/master/docs/en): Core docs in silvershop-core
- [Demo](https://silvershop.fullscreen.io/): Live demo store

## Official modules (silvershop)

- [silvershop/bundles](https://github.com/silvershop/silvershop-bundles): Bundle products for SilverShop: sell a product that groups other products and adjusts component stock on purchase.
- [silvershop/coloredvariations](https://github.com/silvershop/silvershop-coloredvariations): Add color support to variations for SilverShop.
- [silvershop/comparison](https://github.com/silvershop/silvershop-comparison): Submodule for SilverShop which allows you to compare products in a table.
- [silvershop/core](https://github.com/silvershop/silvershop-core): Provides an ecommerce product catalog, shopping cart, and order management system
- [silvershop/discounts](https://github.com/silvershop/silvershop-discounts): Adds Discount and Coupon support for SilverShop.
- [silvershop/geocoding](https://github.com/silvershop/silvershop-geocoding): Geocoding support for SilverShop.
- [silvershop/productcatalog](https://github.com/silvershop/silvershop-productcatalog): Provides the SilverShop Catalog admin for managing products and categories outside of the CMS site tree.
- [silvershop/recipe](https://github.com/silvershop/recipe-silvershop): SilverStripe recipe for fully featured SilverShop Project
- [silvershop/shipping](https://github.com/silvershop/silvershop-shipping): Shipping methods for the SilverShop.
- [silvershop/shopfront](https://github.com/silvershop/silvershop-shopfront): Provides a 'shopfront' page type that can be used to display products or product categories.
- [silvershop/stock](https://github.com/silvershop/silvershop-stock): Adds stock management to SilverShop.

## Supporting libraries (silvershop)

- [silvershop/silverstripe-hasonefield](https://github.com/silvershop/silverstripe-hasonefield): Edit a has_one relationship using a GridField, triggered by clicking a button.
- [silvershop/silverstripe-listsorter](https://github.com/silvershop/silverstripe-listsorter): Easily provide front-end sorting controls for SilverStripe lists
- [silvershop/silverstripe-sqlquerylist](https://github.com/silvershop/silverstripe-sqlquerylist): Wraps a SilverStripe SQLQuery in a SS_List
